pack: P20 Cattle Market — Proof of Modularity
engine: asset-only; no engine code or HTML modifications

basis.reference: Supplied Watch House painted image, previous City Watch Watchman artwork, available painted game HTML.
basis.current_P19_screenshot_status: NOT PROVIDED in these mounted assets; older painted game HTML used for provisional scale. Buddy to confirm against P19.

slots.u_facing_panels: wall_*_u spans 1u; gate spans 2u; each wall rises 50 pixels per storey
slots.v_facing_panels: wall_*_v spans 1v; each wall rises 50 pixels per storey
slots.roof: roof_strip_u_1x2 repeats across building width u, spans complete v=2 depth; placed at z=50*storeys
slots.gable: gable_end_v placed at u=0 and u=buildingWidth, at z=eaves
slots.corner: corner_pier shares each tile-grid wall vertex
slots.foundation: foundation_1x1 shares the exact 56x28 ground diamond
slots.no_rotation: Do NOT rotate or arbitrarily mirror perspective artwork; place using documented u/v direction.
